mapper.select: SELECT p.permission_code FROM admin_permission p JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id=p.id WHERE rp.role_id=#{id} ORDER BY p.permission_code
SELECT permission_code FROM admin_permission WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY permission_code
SELECT m.menu_code FROM admin_menu m JOIN admin_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id=m.id WHERE rm.role_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.sort_order,m.id
